findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Two cans of Jalapeño cheese sauce were observed to be dented. PIC was made aware. The cans were removed from the inventory and stored separately to be returned. Ensure that all food product with compromised package integrity are removed from stock to avoid contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.
